I tried to fill in the right passwords, even changed a password and tried the new one, but still no effect.

Settings: Servertype: POP-mailserver Servername: imap.one.com Port: 995 Username: emailadress

Connectionsecurity SSL/TLS Authenticationmetod: Normal password

I use the release-update-channel (if that is usefull info?)

What can be wrong?
